simple.meaning: אָמַץ (ʼâmats) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to be alert , physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 41 times in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Ruth, 2 Samuel, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 25:23. The surrounding contexts include family, kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָמַץ (H553) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָמַץ (ʼâmats) / H553 is traced through Genesis 25:23, Deuteronomy 2:30, Deuteronomy 3:28, Deuteronomy 15:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.
